subject: general
question: Who among the following athletes won India’s first gold medal in Javelin Throw at the Tokyo Olympics 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Neeraj Chopra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• India's Neeraj Chopra became only the second individual Indian athlete after Abhinav Bindra to be crowned Olympic champion
 
• He won gold in the men's javelin throw at the Tokyo Olympic
 
• The gold medal is also India's first Olympic medal in track-and-field events

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Neeraj Chopra is an Indian track and field athlete who is the reigning Olympic champion and world championship silver medalist in the javelin throw
 
• He is the first Asian athlete to win an Olympic gold medal in men's javelin throw
